professionalSummary.text: Owns release quality end-to-end and holds the quality sign-off that gates each production release.
professionalSummary.witness: Proposed the regression scope for each release in the test planning meeting; the QA lead set the final scope and exit criteria, and the quality sign-off that gated production was given by the QA lead.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Reproduced and triaged defects from the regression runs and from claims operations' acceptance sessions, recording steps, environment and root cause in the defect tracker.

skills.text: Coordinates test scope with the development leads and claims operations and records own responsibility boundaries.
